get.summary: Check for app version and update status
get.description: Checks the current app version against the latest version and returns whether an update is available, and if so, whether it's mandatory.

parameters.name: current_version
parameters.description: The current version of the app

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: The platform of the app (android, ios, or web)

200.description: App version information and update status

is_mandatory.description: Indicates if the update is mandatory

message.description: Message to the user regarding the update status
message.example: A new version is available. Do you want to update?

422.description: Validation error - The request parameters are not valid

message.example: The selected platform is invalid. (and 1 more error)

errors.description: An object containing validation errors for each parameter

post.description: This endpoint verifies the user email using the verification code sent to their email address.
This endpoint allows a user to register by providing their name, email, and password. After registration, an email verification code will be sent to the user.

message.example: Registration successful. A verification code has been sent to your email.

errors.description: An object containing validation errors for each parameter

post.description: Resend a 6-digit email verification code. Ensures the code is not resent if the previous one is still valid.

email.description: The email address of the user.

message.example: A verification code was recently sent. Please wait 1 minute before requesting a new code.
